meta.title: Showcase
meta.description: Let agents verify your changes in a real browser.

hero.title: Showcase
hero.tagline: A skill that lets your coding agent verify its own changes in a real browser.

items.title: Run /showcase inside your agent
items.body: Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP client.

items.title: Showcase reads your diff and drives a real browser
items.body: It generates a plan from the changed files and executes it with Playwright.

items.title: Your agent fixes what breaks, then re-runs to verify
items.body: Failures come back as runtime evidence, not guesses.

items.question: What is Showcase?
items.answer: A placeholder product used by this template. Replace the copy in messages/*.json, the settings in content/site.ts and the demo timeline in content/demo/scene.ts.

items.question: Does it run on my machine?
items.answer: Yes. Everything runs locally through your existing agent. Nothing is uploaded.

items.question: Does it work in CI?
items.answer: Yes. Use the --ci flag to run headless with an automatic timeout.

items.question: Is there a hosted version?
items.answer: Coming soon. Reach out if you have questions.
